project: Wuxia Life P7 Active Life Planning and Attribute Cognition
description: Rework the core playable loop from random-event-driven life playback into an active life planning experience. The execution plan is intentionally split into one-iteration stories: each story has one primary change surface, clear validation, and no hidden expansion into full talent, item, worldbuilding, account, backend, or visual-redesign scope.

userStories.title: Audit Active and Deferred Event Sources
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only inventory of active and deferred event sources so that P7 only plans against reachable runtime content.
acceptanceCriteria: List active runtime event files
List not-wired or deferred event files
Identify event files whose attribute logic is currently unreachable
Produce a short baseline note
Do not modify business code

userStories.title: Audit Time Advancement Entry Points
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the current time advancement paths mapped so that annual-skip fixes target the real sources.
acceptanceCriteria: List main-flow time advancement entry points
List simulator and report time advancement entry points
Classify each entry point as event-defined, fallback, forced annual, or unknown
Produce a short baseline note
Do not modify business code

userStories.title: Audit Attribute Consumption
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to know which active events and systems consume each player attribute so that attribute meaning is based on real gameplay.
acceptanceCriteria: Map active event conditions to player attributes
Map outcome branches to player attributes
Map identity, ending, and report consumers to player attributes
Classify attributes as active, hidden, weakly used, or unused
Do not modify business code

userStories.title: Audit Choice Requirement Visibility
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to compare choice conditions with player-facing UI so that locked or unavailable choices are not silently hidden by implementation details.
acceptanceCriteria: List where choice conditions are evaluated
List where choice requirements are displayed or omitted
Identify silent rejection paths
Produce a gap note for UI and runtime follow-up
Do not modify business code

userStories.title: Define P7 Guardrails
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want P7 scope locked so that active planning does not expand into a complete open world, item system, or talent system.
acceptanceCriteria: Document allowed P7 mechanisms
Document prohibited P7 mechanisms
Document that random events become disturbances and opportunities
Document that ordinary progression must not default to one year
Document required validation by wave

userStories.title: Define Active Action Categories
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a small stable action taxonomy so that ordinary life planning has clear player verbs.
acceptanceCriteria: Define training, study, socializing, travel, business, health, romance, and jianghu action categories
Define which categories are in the P7 minimum implementation
Define which categories are deferred
Document category names, player-facing intent, and non-goals

userStories.title: Define Action Duration Units
userStories.description: As a designer, I want action durations to use month, quarter, and short-stage units so that ordinary life does not jump by years.
acceptanceCriteria: Define month, quarter, short-stage, year, and milestone duration rules
Assign default duration for each P7 minimum action category
Define when year-scale advancement is allowed
Document same-year multi-event display requirements

userStories.title: Define Action Reward and Risk Rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want each action category to have reward, cost, risk, and possible disturbance rules so that actions are not equivalent buttons.
acceptanceCriteria: Define reward channels for each P7 minimum action
Define cost or opportunity-cost channels for each P7 minimum action
Define risk levels for each P7 minimum action
Define how repeated focus changes reward or risk

userStories.title: Add Active Action Types
userStories.description: As a developer, I want typed action definitions so that runtime, UI, reports, and tests can share the same action model.
acceptanceCriteria: Add TypeScript types for action id, category, duration, reward, cost, risk, and metadata
Types are not wired into gameplay runtime yet
Types compile
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Minimum Action Catalog
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a small action catalog for training, study, and socializing so that the first active-planning loop has concrete options.
acceptanceCriteria: Add training action definition
Add study action definition
Add socializing action definition
Each action has duration, reward, cost, and risk metadata
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Action Result Resolver
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a focused resolver for one selected action so that action execution can be tested before UI integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Resolver accepts current state and one action id
Resolver returns state deltas and action result metadata
Resolver supports training, study, and socializing
Resolver does not trigger random disturbances yet
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Test Action Result Resolver
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want action resolver tests so that action rewards and durations do not drift silently.
acceptanceCriteria: Test training action output
Test study action output
Test socializing action output
Test action duration is below one year for minimum actions
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Expose Actions When No Forced Event Exists
userStories.description: As a player, I want the main flow to offer active actions when no forced story event is pending.
acceptanceCriteria: Main flow detects the no-forced-event state
Main flow returns available minimum actions
Existing forced events still take precedence
No UI redesign is introduced
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Execute Selected Active Action
userStories.description: As a player, I want selecting an active action to update the game state and advance the correct short duration.
acceptanceCriteria: Selected action executes through the action resolver
State deltas are applied once
Time advances by action duration rather than one year
Action result is available to the current feedback path
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Record Action History Entries
userStories.description: As a player, I want active actions recorded in history so that reports can distinguish planned life from random events.
acceptanceCriteria: Action execution appends a history or report entry
Entry includes action id, duration, deltas, and source kind
Entry distinguishes active action from story event
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix Main-Flow Annual Fallback
userStories.description: As a player, I want the main gameplay fallback not to advance a full year when ordinary progression is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify the main-flow annual fallback
Replace fallback with action offering or short-duration advancement as appropriate
Forced milestone events retain explicit year-scale advancement
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix Simulator Annual Progression
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the simulator to respect event and action duration instead of forcing one event per year.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulator no longer hardcodes one event per year for ordinary progression
Simulator records same-year multiple events
Milestone annual advancement remains possible when explicitly defined
Relevant simulator check passes

userStories.title: Add Annual Jump Regression Check
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a regression check that reports unintended annual jumps with exact entry points.
acceptanceCriteria: Check detects ordinary progression that advances one full year
Check allows explicit milestone advancement
Failure output includes event id, action id, or source entry point
Relevant check passes

userStories.title: Define Attribute Visibility Tiers
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit, implicit, and semi-implicit attribute visibility tiers so that the player can understand abilities without losing discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Define explicit attribute tier
Define semi-implicit attribute tier
Define implicit attribute tier
Assign current major attributes to tiers
Document always-visible attributes

userStories.title: Define Self-Awareness Visibility Rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want self-awareness to control how clearly hidden attributes appear in the attribute panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Define self-awareness scale or bands
Define fuzzy labels for low visibility
Define numeric or precise labels for high visibility
Define how self-awareness can improve
Document non-goals for this stage

userStories.title: Add Attribute Meaning Definitions
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a data source for player-facing attribute meanings so that the panel does not hardcode stale route advice.
acceptanceCriteria: Add definitions for core explicit attributes
Add definitions for selected implicit attributes
Definitions include purpose, examples, and visibility tier
Definitions are not coupled to stale hardcoded route thresholds
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Render Explicit Attribute Meanings
userStories.description: As a player, I want explicit attributes to show useful meaning in the attribute panel instead of only numbers.
acceptanceCriteria: Attribute panel shows purpose text for explicit attributes
Display fits current panel structure
No unrelated visual redesign is introduced
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Render Implicit Attribute Visibility
userStories.description: As a player, I want implicit attributes to appear as fuzzy or precise information based on self-awareness.
acceptanceCriteria: Panel renders fuzzy descriptions for low-visibility implicit attributes
Panel renders more precise values or labels for high-visibility implicit attributes
Always-hidden implementation details remain hidden
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Remove Stale Attribute Panel Suggestions
userStories.description: As a player, I want attribute guidance to come from current definitions or active content, not outdated hardcoded route requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify hardcoded suggestions that do not match active runtime content
Remove or replace stale suggestions
Panel still provides useful guidance after removal
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix Condition Cache State Hash
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want condition cache keys to include all direct player properties that can affect event and choice eligibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Condition hash includes all direct player properties used by expressions
Charisma, money, comprehension, reputation, connections, and constitution are covered
Flags and triggered events remain covered
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Test Condition Cache Attribute Drift
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want tests proving that changing an attribute used by a condition causes reevaluation.
acceptanceCriteria: Test charisma-dependent condition reevaluates after charisma changes
Test money-dependent condition reevaluates after money changes
Test comprehension-dependent condition reevaluates after comprehension changes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Define Choice Tradeoff Metadata
userStories.description: As a designer, I want structured metadata for reward, cost, risk, and opportunity cost so that choices can be compared without making one option obviously optimal.
acceptanceCriteria: Define reward metadata
Define cost metadata
Define risk metadata
Define opportunity-cost metadata
Document unacceptable one-sided choice patterns

userStories.title: Add Choice Requirement Explanation Model
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a model for explaining choice requirements without exposing raw condition expressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Define explanation output for met requirements
Define explanation output for unmet requirements
Define exact and fuzzy gap representations
Define fallback behavior for unsupported conditions
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Render Locked Choice State
userStories.description: As a player, I want unavailable choices to show a locked state and readable reason before I click them.
acceptanceCriteria: Unavailable choices are visually or textually marked as locked
Lock reason uses player-facing language
Raw condition expressions are not shown
Available choices remain selectable
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Handle Unavailable Choice Clicks
userStories.description: As a player, I want clicking an unavailable choice to produce clear feedback instead of only a console warning.
acceptanceCriteria: Unavailable choice clicks are rejected without state mutation
Player-facing feedback explains why the choice is unavailable
Console-only rejection is no longer the only signal
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Render Action Risk Summary
userStories.description: As a player, I want action choices to show broad reward, cost, and risk before I commit.
acceptanceCriteria: Action choices display reward summary
Action choices display cost or opportunity-cost summary
Action choices display risk level
Risk summary does not reveal hidden branches
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define Random Disturbance Pool
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a small disturbance model so random events become plan modifiers rather than the whole life driver.
acceptanceCriteria: Define disturbance trigger sources
Define minimum disturbance metadata
Define how action type influences disturbance weight
Define how disturbance returns to the action loop

userStories.title: Add Minimal Disturbance Resolver
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a focused resolver that can optionally select a disturbance after an action.
acceptanceCriteria: Resolver accepts action result and current state
Resolver can return no disturbance
Resolver can return one disturbance candidate
Resolver is deterministic in tests when given a deterministic random source
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Wire Disturbance After Action
userStories.description: As a player, I want active actions to sometimes create opportunities or accidents and then return control to the action loop.
acceptanceCriteria: Action execution can invoke disturbance resolver
Resolved disturbance is recorded separately from active action
After disturbance resolution the flow returns to normal progression
No multi-year random-only chain is introduced
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define Report Causal Fields
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want report fields that distinguish active plans, story events, random disturbances, and automatic progression.
acceptanceCriteria: Define source kind field
Define action summary field
Define attribute threshold hit or miss field
Define lock reason summary field

userStories.title: Report Action Distribution
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want reports to show how much life was player-planned versus event-driven.
acceptanceCriteria: Report lists action counts by category
Report lists story event count
Report lists random disturbance count
Report output is deterministic for fixed simulation input
Relevant report check passes

userStories.title: Report Time Granularity Diagnostics
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want reports to expose same-year event counts and unintended annual jumps.
acceptanceCriteria: Report lists same-year event or action counts
Report lists annual jumps
Report distinguishes explicit milestones from unintended jumps
Relevant report check passes

userStories.title: Report Attribute Threshold Outcomes
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want reports to show when attributes unlocked, blocked, or altered outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Report lists key threshold hits
Report lists key threshold misses
Report links threshold outcomes to event, choice, or action ids

userStories.title: Define Extension Boundaries
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want future talents, items, worldbuilding, regions, and factions to plug into the P7 loop without being implemented now.
acceptanceCriteria: Define how talents affect action rewards, cognition, and event weights
Define how items affect actions, thresholds, risks, and branches
Define how worldbuilding, regions, and factions affect action availability and disturbance pools
Document that P7 does not implement complete talent, item, or worldbuilding content

userStories.title: Run P7 Closure Validation
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want proof that P7 changes the game from random life playback into an active planning experience.
acceptanceCriteria: A fixed simulation covers at least one active planning path from age 0 to 30
The player has understandable active actions in every non-forced stage
Ordinary progression no longer behaves as one event per year
The attribute panel explains key attribute meaning and visibility
At least three choices demonstrate non-obvious tradeoffs
Reports explain causal links between key actions, attributes, and results
Closure report lists residual risks and follow-up recommendations
